text:
Try to scratch this Audemars Piguet's bezel. Good luck.

On Audemars Piguet's Royal Oak "Jumbo" Extra-Thin in titanium, the polished bezel and centre bracelet links are made of bulk metallic glass, a palladium alloy AP helped develop.

It's called glass because of how it's made: the metal is cooled in seconds, so it hardens the way glass does instead of like normal metal. The Pd500 stamp on the caseback marks the palladium.

That makes it very hard to scratch, so AP left it mirror-polished, next to brushed titanium and a smoked red dial that fades to near-black at the edge.

AP first tried the mix on a one-off Royal Oak for Only Watch 2021, then released this model in 2023. 39 mm, 8.1 mm thin, automatic. Price on request.
